keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Clement Bischoff (NEC) is shown the yellow card.
Oliver Braude (Heerenveen) is shown the yellow card.
Bryan Linssen (NEC) is shown the yellow card.
Vasilios Zagaritis (Heerenveen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Heerenveen 0, NEC 0.
Marcus Linday (Heerenveen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Heerenveen. Ringo Meerveld replaces Maxence Rivera.
Delay in match because of an injury Jamiro Monteiro (NEC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Heerenveen 1, NEC 0. Dylan Vente (Heerenveen) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Levi Smans.
Substitution, NEC. Ayodele Thomas replaces Clement Bischoff.
Substitution, NEC. Kaj Sierhuis replaces Perr Schuurs.
Substitution, Heerenveen. Dirk Proper replaces Nolhan Courtens.
Substitution, Heerenveen. Luca Oyen replaces Levi Smans.
Substitution, NEC. Gabriel Brás replaces Tobias Storm.
Ayodele Thomas (NEC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, NEC. Adam Tahaui replaces Kevin Kers.
Substitution, NEC. Willum Willumsson replaces Jamiro Monteiro.
Substitution, Heerenveen. Marko Farji replaces Jacob Trenskow.
